title: Custom Cluster
description: Redraws the instrument cluster: a 1987 Grand National dash, or a Sport view round BMW's map while navigating

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.Ef._optional: a plug-in hybrid's battery for Sport's battery bar (config.hybrid)

de.bmw.infotainment.lsc.LSCDataSink._optional: a plug-in hybrid's battery from the charging data sink, Sport's battery bar's fallbacks (config.hybrid)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Charging._optional: a plug-in hybrid's battery from the charging service, Sport's battery bar's fallbacks (config.hybrid)

de.bmw.infotainment.telematic.journeyhis._optional: a plug-in hybrid's battery at the end of the last drive segment, Sport's battery bar's last fallback (config.hybrid)

de.bmw.infotainment.navigation.guiding.G._optional: route guidance on / off (the "While navigating" theme) and the route's progress (Sport's route bar)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's pressure, temperature and distance units (the tyre block, a plug-in hybrid's electric range); a plug-in hybrid's battery as last reported for charging (Sport)

de.bmw.infotainment.misc.MDrive._optional: S or M next to the gear

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.TPMS._optional: tyre pressures and temperatures in the M theme

de.bmw.infotainment.displaydataserver.Di._optional: the Grand National theme's CRUISE lamp

de.bmw.chassis.VehicleStabilizationManag._optional: Auto Hold for the Grand National theme's left lamp

de.bmw.body.steeringwheelcomfort.Steerin._optional: the heated steering wheel for the Grand National theme's HEAT STR lamp

de.bmw.body.DoorsWindowsRoofMirrors._optional: the doors, hood and trunk for the Grand National theme's door lamps

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiInterface_2._optional: BMW's Check Control messages as the cluster gets them (logged, to find when its pop-ups show)

settings.label: Redline (a red mark over the rev scale from here)

config._comment: target panel: the whole 1920x720 instrument cluster, drawn over BMW's gauges. socketPath: cluster-render's documented default. location and utcOffsetMinutes: as in Custom HUD (the clock box). tankLitres: the fuel gauge's full mark when the Fuel tank setting is Auto and the car's model isn't one the app knows (the car sends litres, not the tank size; models known: car/consts.js TANK_BY_MODEL, a 2020 G20 M340i 59 L / 15.6 gal, a 330e 40 L). engine: the peak crank torque (Nm) and power (kW) the {{torquePct}} and {{powerPct}} tokens count from (an M40i: 500 Nm, 285 kW / 382 hp). lamps: the Grand National theme's lamps (the brake lights, BMW's ACC display). hybrid: a plug-in hybrid's battery and electric range for Sport (nothing changes on a car that doesn't send them). checkControl: the Check Control message the cluster shows (KombiIF statusActiveCCMessage, statusMenuCCMessage, KombiInterface_2 newCCMessage), logged on change ("check control"), to find when its pop-ups show. checkControlWindow [x, y, w, h]: while the cluster lists a Check Control message, none of the app's layers draw there, so BMW's pop-up shows through (cluster-render 0.6.3; an older one ignores it).

dme.comment: Boost from the engine unit (DME, ecu 18) over read-only UDS 0x22, only while the sport display sends no boost and a boost readout is shown. Absolute kPa, the outside air pressure (baro) is subtracted. Candidates tried in order, the first plausible one wins. From cauliflowermossgrape's car_vitals (MIT).

boost.note: OBD PID 0x70 boost pressure control: actual boost pressure sensor A (absolute), 1/32 kPa
OBD PID 0x87 intake manifold absolute pressure sensor A, 1/32 kPa
OBD PID 0x0B intake manifold absolute pressure, kPa (max 255 = 1.5 bar boost)

baro.note: OBD PID 0x33 barometric pressure, kPa (101.3 when not available)

volt.note: OBD PID 0x42 control module voltage (the 12 V system), 1/1000 V

pedal.note: OBD PID 0x49 accelerator pedal position D, A * 100 / 255 %
OBD PID 0x4A accelerator pedal position E

pedal.comment: The throttle bar. source obd: OBD PID 0x49 (accelerator pedal position D) from the engine unit, every 250 ms while shown; obdRange [at rest, flat out] in its own % maps to 0..100 (an X3 M40i reads 14.5 at rest, 82 flat out and 91 in kickdown, Nov 7 2026: the app logs 'accelerator pedal (OBD) ... %' on change, set the two from a release and a full press). Without source obd: the AcceleratorPedal message's actualValueAngleAcceleratorPedal * factor + offset, which on an X3 jumped about (misdecoded). kickdown: the OBD reading at or past which the bar's last segment turns red (between flat out, 82, and kickdown, 91).

battery.comment: The 12 V battery's charge: conditionBatteryChargingCondition * factor + offset = %. BMW's charge condition is normally 0..100; if the logged '12 V battery charge condition raw' goes past 100, it is half-percent steps: set factor 0.5.

acc.comment: The car ahead: raw * factor + offset. gap: GapVehicleDrivingAhead's raw value to metres, 0.1 m steps (the 1:1 reading was 10 times BMW's own on the car); rel: DataFrontVehicle's speed to km/h when the car sends it; set: cruiseCtrlSpeedHUD.

fixedSettings._comment: Settings no longer offered (0.1.48): the values the engine reads for them. Grand National's red mark over the rev scale starts at the Redline setting. mapWindow: Sport's map window is always open (0.1.66). units: what the Auto unit settings take until the car says its own.
